messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — I’m handing off night coverage to @Chris in 30m. Quick perms check please: PagerDuty, AWS assume-role, and Grafana dashboard access.
Chris Patel: I’m ready. Can you paste the exact AWS role ARN and the Grafana dashboard URL so I can verify?
Maria Chen: AWS: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall-night-role. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/oncall-overview. PD: you should be in the oncall-sre escalation policy and group 'prod-nights'.
Jordan D: also check that Chris has the pd-admin tag? If not, some manual ack escalations fail.
Chris Patel: running checks now.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff window starting in 30 minutes. See /handoff checklist.
Chris Patel: PagerDuty: can see the prod-nights schedule and my name is listed as primary for tonight. I still don’t see the "ack as proxy" action on the mobile UI — not sure if that’s a perms thing or PD mobile quirk.
Maria Chen: If mobile action is missing, you'll still receive pages. For escalations we rely on the PD web UI for proxy. Check pd role: should be 'Responder' with group membership in the policy.
Chris Patel: AWS: I can assume the role, ran `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall-night-role --role-session-name oncall-check` and got creds back. Verified access to k8s cluster via `kubectl --token=... get pods -n inference` (sanitized).
Alex N: Grafana: tested the dashboard URL, can view graphs but not edit. That's expected — oncall should have view + alert override but not admin. Confirm you can see the alert rule list under Manage -> Alerting -> Alert Rules.
Chris Patel: I can view alert rules and silence alerts. I tried creating a silence and it worked (:thumbsup:).
Jordan D: Quick runbook pointer: if you see high qps + token errors, check the serving runtime pool saturation first. Link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/oncall/serving-pool-saturation. Use runbook step 2 to scale Dedicated pools.
Maria Chen: One gap — Grafana org-level role for Chris is missing the 'Viewer group' mapping for the new infra team. I opened a short-lived request to identity: `ID-REQ-4872` for group mapping. If that doesn’t go through before shift start, call me and I’ll escalate.
Chris Patel: Noted. For PD, I want to test an automated page to make sure routing works. @pagerduty-bot can you trigger a test page to the prod-nights schedule?
pagerduty-bot: Test alert created (PD-TEST-291). It will not notify on-call during night hours if suppression is active.
Chris Patel: Got the test alert ID. I can see it in the PD web UI as triggered. Mobile notification still inconsistent but web is fine — acceptable for tonight.
Maria Chen: Coverage gaps: if both primary+secondary are unavailable (unlikely) we fallback to "eng-platform-oncall" group; their calendar is linked in the runbook. Make sure you have the oncall rotation Slack channel bookmarked: #oncall-rotation.
Jordan D: Two small reminders — 1) enable debug logs on the alerting bridge if you’re investigating delayed alerts (`/bin/alert-bridge --level debug`), and 2) if you need temporary AWS elevation for a customer-impacting incident, follow the emergency-elevations doc: https://security.redwood.internal/elevations (approval required from a pager with admin).
Chris Patel: One last check — can someone confirm I have the Grafana "silence/ack" workflow documented in steps? I want the exact clicks in case of noisy graphs.
Alex N: Copying the quick steps: Dashboard -> Panel with alert -> Click alert icon -> "Create Silence" -> set scope -> Save. Also add a note with incident ID.
Maria Chen: Perfect. I’ve DM’d Identity about the Grafana group mapping and flagged the PD mobile quirk to SRE tools. If anything else pops during the handoff I’ll post here. Taking myself offline in 10. Thanks team. :wave:
Chris Patel: Got it — taking primary now. Will ping if we see any PD escalations or missing perms.
oncall-bot: Handoff complete: Maria Chen -> Chris Patel. New primary: Chris Patel. Secondary: Jordan D.
